QA audit · product review

Aura One — QA audit & product review

2026-10-21 · aura/ (Next.js 16.3.1 · React 19.2.8 · R3F 9.3 · drei 10.7 · three 0.180) — production build, next start on :3456

Method. Production build; Playwright 1.56 + Chromium 151 (Chrome for Testing). Captures used the real Intel UHD 620 via ANGLE/OpenGL because SwiftShader rendered the page at 0.3 fps (see Appendix). Human user-agent forced on every capture: the default HeadlessChrome UA is served the robot view by src/proxy.ts.

All numbers measured on this machine (Intel UHD 620, Chromium 151). 'Not measured' means exactly that.

§1 Executive summary

Visual / design

6 / 10

Strong editorial type and art direction; product reads as a dark silhouette, header collides with content after the hero, explode view is cluttered.

Content accuracy

4 / 10

"Forty parts" shows 15 moving groups; "lossless" Bluetooth claim is technically wrong; fabricated press quotes; privacy policy contradicts the form.

Functionality

4 / 10

Pre-order leads are discarded; the only contact address is on an unregistered domain; no-WebGL visitors get an error page. Anchors, clock, finish picker work.

3D / WebGL

5 / 10

Good: meshopt GLB, no HDRI download, geometry/material disposal and context release on unmount (verified: 3 contexts lost on client nav), context restore works. Bad: 3 contexts, no WebGL fallback, no adaptive quality.

Performance

3 / 10

~9 fps story on an Intel UHD 620; Lighthouse mobile 53 (TBT 17.4 s, LCP 3.2 s); intro holds scroll for 8.5 s. Context loss and unmount disposal verified OK.

Accessibility

7 / 10

axe: 1 violation (footer contrast, 5 nodes); Lighthouse a11y 96; real radios, visible focus rings, labelled story, aria-hidden canvases, reduced motion stops loops. Missing: skip link, 404 landmark.

Responsive

5 / 10

No navigation at all below portrait breakpoint; cookie banner covers the hero headline on phones and tablets; mobile explode has no labels.

SEO & sharing

4 / 10

Canonical/OG/JSON-LD point to localhost; manifest and keywords belong to another project; Product schema for a fictional product.

Security & legal

3 / 10

Critical Next.js advisory, no security headers, open lead endpoint, privacy policy wrong, CC BY attribution incomplete.

Code quality

7 / 10

Strict TS, 0 tsc/ESLint errors, well-commented; but several lint rules disabled, 15 unimported files, 463-line headphones.tsx.

§4 Findings

Click a title to expand why and fix. Click ID, Severity, Category or Effort headers to sort.

Severity
TitleEvidence
F01 P0 Functionality M S133, S134 · data/nowebgl.json (47 words on page, h1 "Something went wrong", console "Error creating WebGL context") · src/views/home/headphones/story-canvas.tsx:142 · src/app/error.tsx:22

Why it matters

R3F throws when the WebGL context cannot be created; the only boundary is the route-level error.tsx, so all copy, specs and the pre-order form disappear. Affects locked-down corporate browsers, GPU-blocklisted machines, some VMs and browsers with hardware acceleration off — exactly the recruiters/clients who open portfolio links on work laptops.

Fix

Check support before mounting (document.createElement("canvas").getContext("webgl2")) and wrap each <Canvas> in its own error boundary that renders the existing robot-view gradient plus a static WebP poster of the model (render one from the current scene). The rest of the page must never depend on the canvas.
F02 P0 Functionality M S039 · data/api-contact.json (200 {"received":true}; no submission in server log) · src/app/api/contact/route.ts:27-40 · next.config.ts:10-14 (removeConsole strips the fallback console.log in production) · no CONTACT_ENDPOINT set

Why it matters

Every lead is lost while the visitor is told they are registered. For a "believable product page" this is the one flow that must work; for a portfolio reviewer who tests it, it is a credibility hit.

Fix

Fail closed: in production return 503 when CONTACT_ENDPOINT is unset and show the error copy. Wire a free sink: a Supabase table (starter already plans Supabase) or a Formspree/Resend free tier. Add a double-opt-in email if you keep the "we'll email you" promise.
F03 P0 Security S data/npm-audit-summary.json — 1 critical (next, direct; vulnerable range <16.3.6), 10 high (mostly dev tooling), yarn audit: 3 critical / 38 high

Why it matters

The framework serving the site is inside a critical advisory range.

Fix

Upgrade next + eslint-config-next to ≥16.3.6, regenerate one lockfile (see F38), rebuild, re-run npm audit --omit=dev.
F04 P0 Legal S S142, S143 · src/data/mocks/legal.ts:25 · src/views/home/buy-section.tsx:74-83

Why it matters

A privacy notice that misstates what personal data is collected is a GDPR transparency failure (Art. 13). The file itself says it must be reviewed before launch.

Fix

Rewrite "What we collect" to cover the pre-order form (name, email, chosen finish, purpose, retention, processor). Add a one-line notice + link under the submit button.
F05 P1 Functionality S data/domain.json (aura.audio → NXDOMAIN for A, MX, SOA) · src/data/home.ts:266 · src/lib/site.ts:35 · src/data/mocks/legal.ts:53

Why it matters

"Talk to us", the footer email and the privacy contact all bounce. Anyone can register the domain and receive the mail.

Fix

Use an address on a domain you own (the company domain, since this is a portfolio piece) and keep it in siteConfig only.
F06 P1 SEO S data/seo.json · src/lib/site.ts:26-28 (fallback when neither NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL nor VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL is set)

Why it matters

Share cards and canonical URLs break on any host that is not Vercel production (preview deploys, Netlify, your own server).

Fix

Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in every environment and make the build fail when it is missing in production instead of silently falling back to localhost.
F07 P1 Legal S src/views/home/index.tsx:49-59 (Product + Offer PreOrder $549 JSON-LD) · src/data/home.ts:237 ("The quietest headphones we've tested" — Sound Weekly …) · disclosure only in the footer blurb, src/data/home.ts:267

Why it matters

Google's structured-data policies prohibit markup for products that cannot be bought; fabricated reviews/press presented as real are deceptive. Disclosing the fiction in 9-point footer text does not offset headline-level claims.

Fix

Drop the Offer (keep a CreativeWork/WebPage schema), label reviews and press "Illustrative — concept product", and put "Concept product — portfolio piece by <company>" near the hero or in the header.
F17 P1 Performance M data/fps.json — scroll through the story, desktop 1440×900 DPR 1: 9.1 fps avg, p50 116.6 ms, p95 149.9 ms, 100 % of frames > 33 ms; mobile 390×844 DPR 2: 10.6 fps; 4× CPU throttle barely changes it (8.6 / 11.2 fps) ⇒ GPU-bound · idle: story 10.2 fps, #finishes 9.2 fps, #moments 31.2 fps · data/drawcalls.json: 51 draws / 64,659 tris per frame in the story, 84 draws / 129,299 tris at #finishes

Why it matters

UHD 620 is the integrated GPU in a huge share of office laptops. The cost is fill-rate (full-screen MSAA ×4 composer + bloom mip chain + vignette), not geometry: 65 k triangles is light. A 9 fps scroll story reads as broken, not premium. Headless compositing adds some overhead, but not a 6× gap.

Fix

In order: drop EffectComposer multisampling to 0 and use the canvas antialias, halve bloom resolution, cap DPR at 1.25 for the full-screen canvas, add <PerformanceMonitor> to step down further (F18), and stop rendering the turntables when the story canvas is visible (and vice versa). Re-measure with perf.mjs after each step.
F39 P1 Performance M data/lighthouse-summary.json — mobile (real page): Perf 53, FCP 1.2 s, LCP 3.24 s, TBT 17,391 ms, SI 11.7 s, CLS 0; desktop: Perf 60, LCP 0.74 s, TBT 3,764 ms · LCP element = chapter-01 body paragraph (opacity-animated <p class="absolute w-100 text-body …">) · total weight 1,197,663 B, largest request aura-one.glb 547,959 B · S002

Why it matters

TBT that high means the main thread is busy almost continuously after load (render loop + fitModel × 3 + PMREM bakes + hydration). The LCP text waits for its spring to fade in.

Fix

Render the hero headline/body visible in server HTML (animate transform only, not opacity from 0), defer the two turntable canvases until they approach the viewport, memoise fitModel across canvases (F36), and fix F17. Track with Lighthouse on the real UA.
F08 P2 Performance S src/utils/bot-ua.ts:11 (regex includes lighthouse|pagespeed|headlesschrome|gtmetrix|pingdom) · src/proxy.ts:17 · S136 · data/lighthouse-summary.json: the local Lighthouse 12 CLI UAs do not contain "Lighthouse", so those runs measured the real page (identical 1,197,663 B in all four runs)

Why it matters

Any lab tool that identifies itself scores a page real visitors never get, so its numbers cannot be quoted in a portfolio. Serving crawlers different HTML is "dynamic rendering", which Google documents as a deprecated workaround.

Fix

Keep the robot view for search/AI crawlers only; remove lighthouse/pagespeed/headlesschrome/gtmetrix/pingdom from the regex so lab tools measure the real page — then fix what they report.
F09 P1 SEO S public/manifest.json:2-8 (name, short_name "Layers", description, background/theme #f4ece0) · src/utils/seo/generate-page-metadata.ts:46-53 (keywords "animation studio", "2D animation" …) · public/browserconfig.xml

Why it matters

Installing the site as an app shows "Layers"; the cream theme colour flashes on Android splash. A reviewer who opens devtools sees copy-paste from another site.

Fix

Rewrite manifest.json (Aura, #0b0a09), delete the keywords array (ignored by Google anyway), regenerate the icon set from an Aura mark.
F10 P1 Visual S S022, S026, S033, S062, S066, S121, S124, S125 · src/views/home/site-header.tsx:19 (only a 60%→0 scrim gradient)

Why it matters

Headings and body copy overlap the logo, nav and clock at every viewport once you leave the story — the most visible polish defect on the page.

Fix

After the story section unpins, give the header bg-background/80 + backdrop-blur and a hairline border (one IntersectionObserver on the story section), and add scroll-margin-top to anchored sections.
F11 P1 Responsive M S144, S145 · data/misc.json (navLinksVisible 0, menuButtonFound false at 390 and 768 px) · src/views/home/site-header.tsx:28 (max-portrait:hidden)

Why it matters

The story is 16 viewports tall; on mobile the only way to reach specs or reviews is to scroll through all of it.

Fix

Add a menu button that opens a sheet with the 4 anchors + pre-order, or a sticky "Skip story ↓" chip during the pinned section.
F12 P1 Visual M S053, S054 ("1 200 mAh cell" label printed over "Cushion, acoustic grille…") · src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:125-134 (fixed pin offsets, no screen-space collision check)

Why it matters

The climax of the story — "take them apart" — becomes unreadable on the most common laptop/tablet landscape size.

Fix

Fade the chapter body out while callouts are shown (callouts already have a shown flag), or move the body to the opposite corner for chapter 04; long-term replace callouts with the hotspot system (Proposal P3).
F13 P1 Content S S014, S053, S112 · src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:57-65 (7 parts × 2 cups + headband), :300-335 (driver = lathe cone, board = box, battery = RoundedBox) · src/data/home.ts:65

Why it matters

The headline promises a count the visuals contradict, and the code-built inner parts (flat box "DSP board", plain battery brick) are the most "CG-looking" frames on the page. At 0.55 progress the parts also overlap each other.

Fix

Change the copy to what is shown ("Fifteen parts. Every one replaceable.") or show 40 labelled items in a flat-lay grid; add bevels/chips/traces to the board, and increase the per-part spacing (PARTS offsets) so pieces do not overlap.
F14 P1 Legal S src/components/common/Cookie/cookieStore.ts:60-61 · data/cookie.json (after Accept all: analytics false, marketing false) · S100, S144, S145 (banner covers the hero headline) · no analytics or marketing scripts in the build

Why it matters

A consent UI whose "accept" does nothing is misleading, and a banner with no non-essential tracking is pure friction — on phones it hides the h1 and is the LCP element.

Fix

Remove the banner until analytics exist. If you add analytics, use a cookieless one (Proposal P10) and fix acceptAll to set analytics/marketing true.
F15 P1 Performance S src/views/home/preloader.tsx:19-20, 41-47 · node_modules/@react-spring/rafz/dist/react-spring_rafz.modern.mjs:123 (frame delta clamped to 64 ms ⇒ the 2.7 s timeline needs ≥ 42 frames) · data/load.json: on the real UHD 620 the preloader is removed at 8,499 ms (desktop) / 6,866 ms (mobile) instead of 2,700 ms · SwiftShader 0.3 fps → counter "001" after 10 s

Why it matters

On any device rendering < 15 fps behind the intro (shader compile + PMREM + GLB decode happen at the same time), the intro runs longer than its 2.7 s while scrolling is held. The counter is a fake: it is not tied to loading at all.

Fix

Drive the intro by wall-clock time, end it when drei useProgress reports the model ready (or after a 2.5 s cap), and add a "Skip" button / allow scroll to dismiss.
F16 P1 3D/WebGL M data/gl-*.json (3 contexts at every viewport) · src/views/home/finishes-section.tsx:28 · src/views/home/moments-orbit.tsx:72 · src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:380 (fitModel runs per instance) · studio-lights.tsx:21 (an Environment/PMREM per canvas)

Why it matters

Triple GPU memory for textures and geometry, three shader compiles, three PMREM bakes, and fitModel (CPU geometry cutting of 59 k triangles) three times. Mobile Safari evicts the oldest context when memory runs short.

Fix

One fixed full-screen <Canvas> with drei <View> portals for the story, finishes and moments slots (same scene, scissored), or replace the moments-ring model with a static WebP of the current finish.
F18 P1 3D/WebGL S src/views/home/headphones/story-canvas.tsx:143-154 · finish-canvas.tsx:86-87 · no PerformanceMonitor / AdaptiveDpr anywhere

Why it matters

Fill-rate cost scales with DPR² × MSAA samples; there is no fallback path for weak GPUs (see FPS table).

Fix

Wrap the canvas in drei <PerformanceMonitor> and step down DPR (1.75→1.25→1), multisampling (4→0) and drop Bloom when fps < 45; render on demand when the scroll is idle and reduced motion is on.
F21 P1 Security S data/api-contact.json (60 rapid valid POSTs → 60× 200, no 429; Origin: https://evil.example → 200; no honeypot)

Why it matters

The moment F02 is fixed and leads go to a CRM or inbox, it becomes a spam/abuse relay.

Fix

Reject requests whose Origin is not the site, add a hidden honeypot field, and rate-limit per IP (Upstash free tier, or an in-memory token bucket on a single instance).
F19 P3 3D/WebGL S S148 (lost), S149 (restored) · data/contextloss.json: after loseContext()/restoreContext() the model came back at 51 draws / 64,659 tris per frame, no console errors · no "webglcontextlost" listener in src/

Why it matters

three/R3F restore works (verified). While lost — or if the browser never restores — the stage is empty with no explanation.

Fix

Listen for webglcontextlost on gl.domElement (onCreated) and show the static poster (P1) until restored.
F20 P2 Security S data/security-headers.json — no CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy on /, /privacy-policy, assets

Why it matters

Clickjacking and MIME-sniffing protections are free; reviewers run securityheaders.com on portfolio links.

Fix

Add headers() in next.config.ts: HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors 'none' / XFO DENY, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy, and a CSP that allows 'self' + blob: for workers.
F22 P2 Performance S data/security-headers.json (GLB max-age=0) · data/assets.json (aura-one.glb 723,500 B, gzip 547,251 B)

Why it matters

Every repeat visit revalidates the largest asset.

Fix

Fingerprint the file name (aura-one.<hash>.glb) and serve it immutable for a year via headers().
F23 P2 Legal S src/data/home.ts:270-275 · data/glb.json asset.extras (author SofiaWolfie, CC-BY-4.0) · modifications in src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:88-89, 247-257 (colour maps dropped, maker's-mark normal map removed, mesh cut into parts) · obsidian ADR-0037 still says "zero 3D asset bytes" (data/decisions-summary.md)

Why it matters

CC BY 4.0 §3(a)(1)(B) requires indicating that changes were made. The removed "maker's mark" should be checked: if the source model reproduces a real brand's product, that is third-party design/trademark risk (not verified).

Fix

Footer: "Headphones" by SofiaWolfie, CC BY 4.0 — recoloured and split into parts. Check the Sketchfab page for the original brand reference; update ADR-0037.
F24 P2 Content S src/data/home.ts:158, 182 ("Lossless over the air — 24-bit / 96 kHz … LDAC and aptX Lossless") · :209, 213 ("5 Hz — lowest note the driver reaches")

Why it matters

aptX Lossless is CD-quality (16-bit/44.1 kHz) only; LDAC at 24/96 is lossy. 5 Hz is infrasound, not a "note". Audio people are the target buyer.

Fix

"Hi-res over the air: LDAC up to 24-bit/96 kHz, aptX Lossless at CD quality"; "Response 5 Hz – 40 kHz" without the "note" framing.
F25 P2 Visual M S002, S003, S041, S100 (hero) · S020 vs S030 (Obsidian vs Midnight) · backdrop.tsx:14-15 (#2e2821→#0b0a09) · story-canvas.tsx:153 (Vignette darkness 0.65) · home.ts:113-134 (shell #18171b vs #1d2b40)

Why it matters

The hero should sell the object; at 1440×900 more than half the model is within a few % of the background luminance. The gold-on-black specular hits are what reads as "CG".

Fix

Lift the backdrop pool and add a cool rim/kicker from camera-left; lower vignette to ~0.4; lighten Midnight shell (e.g. #2a3c58) and add a soft contact shadow so the model sits in space.
F27 P2 Visual S S005, S008, S011, S044, S076 (body text at low opacity over the cups) · S110 (mobile: "Forty parts" cut at the left edge while sliding in) · chapter-caption.tsx:23-27 (5 rem slide, 0.74-0.9 fade window)

Why it matters

A third of the scroll positions show half-faded text sitting on the product; on 390 px the 5 rem slide pushes the headline outside the gutter.

Fix

Shorten the fade windows, hide the body copy entirely between chapters, and use a 1-2 rem slide (or opacity only) under max-mobile.
F28 P2 Visual S S020, S029, S031, S059 · finish-canvas.tsx:50 (initial yaw −0.6) · finishes-section.tsx:29-31 (hint at text-foreground/50, 12 px)

Why it matters

The colour picker is the one "configurator" moment and the product is not framed for it.

Fix

Start at a 3/4 front angle, centre and enlarge the model (camera z 10.5 → ~8), and show the drag hint as a pill that animates once.
F29 P2 Accessibility S data/a11y.json — axe color-contrast (serious), 5 nodes on desktop and mobile: © 2026 Aura, model credit link, CC BY 4.0 link, Privacy, Back to the top (site-footer.tsx:44, text-foreground/50 at 12 px) · Lighthouse a11y 96, same audit · data/contrast.json: cream @0.50 = 4.48:1 on #151311, 4.505:1 on #0b0a09; finishes hint (finishes-section.tsx:29) uses the same value

Why it matters

12 px mono uppercase at the AA threshold is hard to read for low-vision users and on glossy phone screens.

Fix

Use /60 as the floor for meta text (6.0:1).
F32 P2 Functionality S S039 · src/views/home/buy-section.tsx:84-93

Why it matters

Users double-submit; there is no clear confirmation and no consent/privacy line at the point of collection.

Fix

Replace the form with a confirmation card on success (finish, email, "check your inbox"), disable the button, add the privacy line (F04).
F33 P2 Responsive M S111-S113 · src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:349 (callouts max-mobile:hidden)

Why it matters

The model is ~1/3 of the screen width when apart; without labels the chapter is an abstract shape.

Fix

Numbered pins on the model + a numbered legend under the headline (Proposal P3).
F37 P2 Code S src/app/error.tsx:21-31 (plain "Something went wrong" — S133) · no src/app/global-error.tsx

Why it matters

Errors in the root layout show Next's default page; the existing boundary is off-brand and swallows the whole page (F01).

Fix

Per-canvas boundaries (F01), a styled error.tsx with header/footer, and global-error.tsx.
F42 P2 Performance S src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx:379 (useGLTF without useGLTF.preload) · data/load.json: DOMContentLoaded 172 ms but GLB responseEnd 1,935 ms (desktop, localhost, no network throttle); first frame with the model 4,068 ms

Why it matters

The 723 KB fetch waits for hydration of the client bundle instead of starting with the HTML.

Fix

useGLTF.preload(MODEL_URL) at module scope plus <link rel="preload" href="/assets/models/aura-one.glb" as="fetch" crossorigin> in the layout.
F26 P3 Visual S S010, S078, S107 · src/views/home/ghost-words.tsx:39 (text-foreground/5 → 1.08:1)

Why it matters

Too faint to read, visible enough to look like a rendering artefact over the gold cap.

Fix

Either commit (10-12 %, behind the model only, mix-blend-overlay) or delete.
F43 P3 Accessibility S data/a11y.json keyboard — 28 tab stops; first stop is the logo (#top), no skip link; focus rings visible on every stop (S150, S151) except the two sr-only swatch radios, whose ring is drawn on the sibling swatch; 0 stops hidden under the fixed header; canvases are aria-hidden and the story section is aria-labelled

Why it matters

Keyboard support is otherwise good; a "Skip to finishes" link would save keyboard and screen-reader users the pinned stretch.

Fix

Add a visually-hidden-until-focused link as the first element in the header (pairs with Proposal P8).
F30 P3 Visual S S140, S141 · src/app/not-found.tsx:7-16 · data/a11y.json: axe landmark-one-main + region (moderate) on /this-page-does-not-exist

Why it matters

No header, no logo, default type — inconsistent with the rest of the piece.

Fix

Reuse SiteHeader/SiteFooter, display serif "Nothing to hear here.", link back to the story and to pre-order.
F31 P3 Accessibility S S135 · data/nojs.json (1,305 words in HTML, but the per-letter headline spans start hidden)

Why it matters

Robots are handled by the proxy, but no-JS humans (and failed hydration) see a hero without a headline.

Fix

Add a <noscript> style that forces the written-lines letters visible (the layout already does this for the preloader).
F34 P3 Code S data/deps-unused.json — resize-observer-polyfill (0 references); unimported: springs/handle, springs/hover, springs/spring-trigger, scroll-sequence, use-image-sequence path, skeleton-image/-loader/-video, use-in-view-ref, use-on-shown, use-after-load, style/index.css, coords, is-bot, lvh …

Why it matters

Starter leftovers make the repo look unreviewed to anyone reading the code of a portfolio piece.

Fix

Remove resize-observer-polyfill; delete the unimported starter files that are not part of the vendored engine (springs/ needs sign-off per AGENTS.md).
F35 P3 Code S eslint.config.mjs:19-28 (no-unused-vars, no-explicit-any, prefer-const, no-unused-expressions … off) · AGENTS.md rule 7 says "No any"

Why it matters

0 lint errors is partly because the checks are disabled.

Fix

Re-enable no-unused-vars (warn) and no-explicit-any (error) and fix the fallout.
F36 P3 Code M data/deps-unused.json largest files · src/views/home/headphones/headphones.tsx

Why it matters

Hard to test or reuse (e.g. for the hotspot system or a poster render).

Fix

Split into fit-model.ts (pure, testable), inner-parts.tsx, callouts.tsx, headphones.tsx; memoise fitModel per GLTF scene (WeakMap) so multiple canvases share it.
F38 P3 Code S data/npm-audit-summary.json (package-lock 21:10, package.json/yarn.lock 21:23)

Why it matters

CI and Vercel may install different trees than you test.

Fix

Pick yarn (matches the starter) and delete package-lock.json.
F40 P3 Content S S147 · data/misc.json (ticks 22:13:02 → 22:13:05) · src/views/home/live-clock.tsx:19-20

Why it matters

Works, but the label implies the studio's timezone.

Fix

Format with Intl.DateTimeFormat({ timeZone: "<studio tz>" }) and add the city, e.g. "Studio · Karachi 22:13".
F41 P3 3D/WebGL S data/glb-unused.json (5 base-colour-only textures, 26,728 B) · headphones.tsx:248 (material.map = null)

Why it matters

Small, but it is decode work and GPU memory ×3 contexts.

Fix

Strip baseColorTexture in the gltf-transform pipeline that produced the file.
F44 P3 Responsive S S041, S053 (1024 px: "REVIEWS" and "STUDIO" ~16 px apart)

Why it matters

Looks unbalanced at a common laptop width.

Fix

Hide the clock below 1200 px or reduce nav gap from gap-10 to gap-6 there.

§7 New feature proposals

Ordered by impact, then effort. Nothing here is built; mockups are static prototypes.

P1

Honest loading + no-WebGL poster

Impact Effort M

Problem
Fake 0-100 counter, scroll lock, blank error page without WebGL (F01, F15).
Value
Every visitor gets the product in < 1 s (poster), the 3D swaps in when ready; reviewers on locked-down laptops still see the work.
Approach
drei useProgress for real bytes; render a poster WebP from the existing scene once (gl.domElement.toDataURL in a dev-only route) into public/; preloader.tsx ends on ready or 2.5 s cap with a Skip button; WebGL check + per-canvas error boundary around StoryCanvas/FinishCanvas.
Risks
Poster must be re-rendered when finishes or lighting change.
P2

Hotspot / annotation system on the model

Impact Effort M

Problem
Callouts collide with copy on tablets and vanish on phones (F12, F33).
Value
An interactive, accessible "inside" view: numbered pins → card with detail; keyboard and screen-reader friendly; works at every viewport.
Approach
Reuse CALLOUT_PINS + insideCallouts; drei <Html occlude> pins that are real <button>s; one active card rendered in DOM outside the canvas; aria-describedby; arrow keys step through parts and drive the explode target.
Risks
Html occlusion cost per frame — keep ≤ 5 pins; pins must not trap focus during scroll.
P3

Real pre-order flow (Finish → Details → Confirm)

Impact Effort M

Problem
Leads are discarded (F02); no consent, no confirmation.
Value
Shows full-stack depth in the portfolio: validated form, persistence, confirmation email, idempotency.
Approach
Drawer/step component in views/home/preorder/; zod schema shared client/server; /api/preorder writes to Supabase (free) with a unique email constraint; Resend free tier sends confirmation; honeypot + origin check + rate limit (F21); copy states "concept product — no payment ever".
Risks
Must be clearly labelled as a concept so nobody believes they ordered a real product; GDPR notice (F04).
P4

Case study: "How we built Aura One"

Impact Effort M

Problem
Nothing on the site says who built it or how — the portfolio value is invisible.
Value
Turns a demo into a sales asset: process, decisions (single GLB, code-built inner parts, robot view), measured performance, before/after.
Approach
New route app/case-study/page.tsx → views/case-study/; reuse LegalDocument-style server component; embed real numbers from this audit after fixes; link from header and footer; its own OG image via next/og.
Risks
Only publish numbers you re-measure after fixes; avoid claiming Lighthouse scores from the robot view (F08).
P6

Performance mode (Auto / High / Battery saver)

Impact Effort S

Problem
No adaptive quality (F18); weak GPUs get a slideshow.
Value
Smooth on low-end devices; demonstrates WebGL engineering judgement.
Approach
drei <PerformanceMonitor> sets a zustand quality level; level drives dpr, EffectComposer multisampling/Bloom on/off, Environment resolution; a small settings popover persists the choice in localStorage; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Risks
Avoid oscillation — use PerformanceMonitor flipflops limit and a fallback to "Battery saver".
P8

Story progress rail + "Skip story"

Impact Effort S

Problem
16 viewports of pinned scroll with no indication of length, no way past it on mobile (F11).
Value
Orientation and control; lowers bounce from impatient visitors.
Approach
Fixed 5-dot rail driven by the existing progress (product-store), each dot an anchor to the chapter scroll offset; "Skip to finishes ↓" button using lenis.scrollTo.
Risks
Must not compete with the header on 390 px — place bottom-right above the ticker.

No mockup for this proposal.

P9

Launch-page content & SEO kit

Impact Effort S

Problem
Thin crawlable content, wrong manifest/keywords (F09), Product schema for a fictional item (F07).
Value
Indexable FAQ, comparison and care sections; correct share previews per section.
Approach
FAQ section (FAQPage JSON-LD) in data/home.ts; next/og opengraph-image.tsx rendering the poster + headline; fix manifest; "Concept product" disclosure in hero.
Risks
FAQ rich results are limited to authoritative sites — value is mainly content and shares.

No mockup for this proposal.

P5

Finish & cushion configurator with shareable URL

Impact Effort M

Problem
The picker exists but the stage is small and off-centre (F28) and choices are not shareable.
Value
A believable product-page moment; ?finish=sand deep links; reviewers can send a configured link.
Approach
Extend product-store.ts with cushion option + URL sync (useSearchParams + router.replace); one canvas via drei <View> (fixes F16); price line updates; colourway data stays in data/home.ts.
Risks
Material variants for cushion need a second normal map — reuse the GLB's leather normal for both and vary roughness/colour only.
P7

Interactive frequency-response chart

Impact Effort S

Problem
Specs are a list of numbers with no "sound" story.
Value
Audio-literate visitors get something to play with; good data-viz showcase.
Approach
Inline SVG component in views/home/sound-section.tsx; data as a typed array in data/home.ts; log-x scale written by hand (no chart lib); toggles for ANC/transparency; keyboard-accessible readout.
Risks
Any curve is invented for a fictional product — label "Illustrative" permanently.
P10

Cookieless analytics + scroll-depth events

Impact Effort S

Problem
No way to know how far visitors get through the story or if they reach pre-order.
Value
Real data for the case study; justifies removing the cookie banner (F14).
Approach
Self-hosted Umami (free) or Vercel Web Analytics hobby; fire events at chapter boundaries from ProductStory handleProgress and on form submit.
Risks
Keep it cookieless so no consent banner is required.

No mockup for this proposal.

P11

ANC on/off sound preview

Impact Effort M

Problem
"What you hear, and what you don't" is all text.
Value
An emotional, memorable moment — a train cabin ambience that drops away when ANC is toggled.
Approach
Web Audio API: one CC0 ambience loop + low-pass/gain node to simulate ANC; button in sound-section; no autoplay; respects reduced motion for any visual meter.
Risks
Audio licensing (use CC0 only), file size (≤ 300 KB Opus), and honesty — label as a simulation.

No mockup for this proposal.

3D

  • aura-one.glb (Sketchfab "Headphones" by SofiaWolfie, CC BY 4.0) — 9 meshes, 59,144 triangles, 33,872 vertices, 20 WebP textures 1024², EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization, 723,500 B
  • Loaded once via drei useGLTF, baked + cut at runtime into 15 parts (headband + 7 per cup); procedural driver (lathe), board (box), battery (RoundedBox)
  • Materials: MeshStandardMaterial clones, colour maps dropped; colourway lerps per frame
  • Lighting: ambient + warm spot + gold directional + drei <Environment> built from 4 <Lightformer>s (no HDRI download), 256 px
  • Story canvas: 1440×900 backdrop plane with canvas-texture gradient, EffectComposer (MSAA ×4) with Bloom (mipmap) + Vignette, DPR [1, 1.75], tone mapping = R3F default (ACESFilmic), no shadows
  • Finish canvas ×2 (finishes + moments): same model, alpha canvas, antialias, DPR [1, 1.75]
  • Render loops pause via IntersectionObserver (frameloop "never" off-screen)

Scroll

  • Lenis smooth wheel (layouts/scroll-layout.tsx); ProgressTrigger reports 0-1 over the pinned story
  • SHOTS table (story-canvas.tsx:45-61): 11 keyframes of yaw/pitch/distance/x/y/explode, eased + damped (5/s)
  • Explode 0→1 between 63-72 % progress, staggered per part (6 % stagger), headband lifts 0.95; callouts above 0.9 explode
  • Captions: per-letter written headlines, misted body, slide 5 rem from their side; ghost words rise/fade
  • Idle float + pointer tilt (off under reduced motion)
  • Inview rise-ins on every section after the story; marquees (paused under reduced motion)

Controls

  • Header anchors + CTA

Could not be measured

  • SwiftShader captures: the requested --use-angle=swiftshader mode rendered this page at 0.3 fps (preloader counter at 006 after ~10 s; a screenshot after 45 s timed out at 30 s). All captures and FPS numbers therefore use the real Intel UHD 620 GPU via ANGLE/OpenGL in headless Chromium — headless compositing may cost a little more than a headed browser.
  • Real phones and Safari/iOS: no physical device or WebKit run. Mobile numbers are Chromium with a 390×844 viewport, DPR 2 and an iPhone UA on a laptop GPU.
  • PageSpeed Insights: not run (needs the site on a public URL). Its UA is believed to contain "Chrome-Lighthouse", which src/utils/bot-ua.ts would route to the robot view — not verified here.
  • Local Lighthouse 12 CLI runs used emulated UAs without "Lighthouse" in them, so all four runs audited the real WebGL page (identical 1,197,663 B weight) — the "default" vs "human" UA split did not change what was served.
  • GPU memory per WebGL context: no reliable browser API; inferred from texture counts only.
  • Native form-validation bubble text and OS-level screen-reader output (NVDA/VoiceOver) were not captured.
  • Model licence on Sketchfab and whether the removed "maker's mark" belongs to a real brand: no network check performed; credit data taken from the GLB asset.extras.
  • Trademark availability of "Aura" in the audio category: not searched.
  • Production hosting headers (Vercel/other CDN): only next start locally was tested.
  • Reduced motion, story canvas: two canvas screenshots 2 s apart differed slightly (321,309 vs 321,365 B) with float/tilt off — cause (damping settle, bloom noise or encoder) not isolated.
  • Touch: vertical swipes scroll the page (385 px) including on the turntable; horizontal swipe on it does not scroll (data/a11y.json). Momentum, pinch-zoom and iOS rubber-banding were not tested. No viewport-fit=cover is set, so iOS keeps its default safe-area insets — no notch overlap expected, not verified on a device.
